experienceTypes.labelVi: Ẩm thực & hương vị đời thường

hardFiltersBeforeAI: place has usable operating window for requested date
place has approved planning cost or explicit zero-cost confirmation
place is compatible with group/accessibility/dietary hard constraints when provided

aiContract.input: Only structured candidate places from hard filters plus user preferences.
aiContract.output: Return ordered placeIds only, with score and short reason. AI must not invent a place, price, opening hour or travel time.
rankingGuidance: Apply experience priority as a soft weight, not a hard filter.
Prefer diversity when several categories have similar score.
Prefer lower transfer time and better budget fit.

deterministicValidationAfterAI: Resolve every returned placeId from DB; reject unknown IDs.
Schedule visit windows and transfer buffers.
estimatedCost = sum(planningCost allowance appropriate to itinerary) × group size.
Check each arrival/departure against operating windows.
Reject/repair route if time, budget or travel feasibility fails.
If one stop fails, drop the lowest-ranked conflicting stop and validate again.
If too few candidates remain, use nearby_fallback only with a visible note to the user; never invent data.
plannerRules.uiRule: If requested duration is below an area minimum (especially Củ Chi), disable that area or show a clear adjustment message instead of fabricating an itinerary.
plannerRules.originCaveat: Without a pickup/start location, travel feasibility can only be checked between itinerary stops. For Củ Chi, add a pickup point or a documented prototype origin before treating transport time as complete.

travelMatrix.note: Ước tính nội bộ cho prototype, không thay cho dữ liệu bản đồ thực tế. QTV cần duyệt trước khi sử dụng.
